name: MEMX Memory Observation Alerts
description: Alert rules for MEMX memory metrics and performance thresholds

alerts.name: MEMX High Memory Strain
alerts.description: Memory strain percentage exceeds 80% for more than 5 minutes

annotations.description: Memory strain has been above 80% for {{ $duration }}. Current value: {{ $value }}%

alerts.name: MEMX Critical Memory Strain
alerts.description: Memory strain percentage exceeds 95% for more than 2 minutes

annotations.description: Memory strain has been above 95% for {{ $duration }}. Current value: {{ $value }}%. Immediate action required.

alerts.name: MEMX WASM Heap Growth
alerts.description: WASM heap size exceeds 20MB for more than 10 minutes

annotations.summary: MEMX WASM heap is growing large
annotations.description: WASM heap size has been above 20MB for {{ $duration }}. Current value: {{ $value }} bytes

alerts.name: MEMX SAB Backlog
alerts.description: SharedArrayBuffer usage exceeds 90% for more than 3 minutes

annotations.description: SAB usage has been above 90% for {{ $duration }}. Current value: {{ $value }}%

alerts.name: MEMX AudioWorklet Lag
alerts.description: AudioWorklet lag exceeds 100ms for more than 5 minutes

annotations.description: AudioWorklet lag has been above 100ms for {{ $duration }}. Current value: {{ $value }}ms

alerts.name: MEMX Frame Drops
alerts.description: Frame drop rate exceeds 5% for more than 2 minutes

annotations.summary: MEMX frame drop rate is high
annotations.description: Frame drop rate has been above 5% for {{ $duration }}. Current value: {{ $value }}%

alerts.name: MEMX Export Failures
alerts.description: Export failure rate exceeds 10% for more than 5 minutes

annotations.summary: MEMX export failure rate is high
annotations.description: Export failure rate has been above 10% for {{ $duration }}. Current value: {{ $value }}%

alerts.name: MEMX OTel Disconnect
alerts.description: OTel collector is not receiving MEMX metrics for more than 5 minutes

annotations.description: No MEMX metrics received for {{ $duration }}. Check OTel collector and MEMX instrumentation.

alerts.name: MEMX Session Stall
alerts.description: No new frames received for more than 30 seconds

annotations.description: No new frames received for {{ $duration }}. Check browser instrumentation and MEMX store.

alerts.name: MEMX Cross-Origin Isolation
alerts.description: Cross-origin isolation is disabled, affecting SAB/WASM functionality

annotations.description: Cross-origin isolation is disabled for {{ $duration }}. SAB and WASM threads may not function properly.
